ticket.model_delta_expectation: ZERO. Document the no-op with evidence.
ticket.objective: THE severe one, owner-verified twice: six lines of YAML declaring a one-component partition make the divergent fixture -- four real divergences -- report `coherent`, exit 0. The refusal AC-01 built lives on the EMERGENT path and the DECLARED path walks around it: the guard reads `if not unported_pairs and len(names) >= 2`, `divergence_detectable` is computed and no consumer reads it, and a declared partition the descriptor itself prints as DOES NOT DECOMPOSE is consumed with the failed criteria appearing nowhere in the text or the JSON (`blind_spots: []`). Measured blast radius over all 203 partitions of the ex5 fixture: 12 report `coherent` and ALL 12 fail the criteria, while 0 of the honest partitions produce a clean. This is the MF-027 false-clean class, which this epic's own doctrine forbids outright. Fix: the basis travels with the verdict -- partition origin, every criterion with its measurement, and `divergence_detectable` -- in BOTH the text and the JSON; a partition that cannot express a divergence cannot yield `coherent` whatever its component count; and the `[]`-where-text-says- NOT-MEASURABLE JSON asymmetry (AC-03-DF-01) is closed in the same pass, since a consumer reading `[]` as "owns nothing" is the same defect one field over.
ticket.outcome: Closed. All twelve of EV-02's false cleans are gone (203-partition sweep: 12 coherent -> 0) and the ex4 false-positive control still reports `coherent` honestly. Three deliberate departures from the brief, all recorded with the measurement that decided them: (1) the refusal is filed as a BASIS LIMIT rather than a blind spot, so it withholds a `coherent` and never a finding -- filing it as a blind spot removes the same twelve false cleans and suppresses 67 of the 71 real divergence verdicts to do it; (2) the declared partition is never refused outright, per NEXT-EPIC NE-01(3) -- the comparison runs, findings keep their file:line, exit 0; (3) the `[]`-not-`null` rule was applied to the reflexion finding lists as well as to `components[].owns`, since a `divergences: []` on a comparison that never ran is the same defect one field over. Two findings recorded rather than deferred: this repository's OWN declared four-component partition does not decompose its own model (Q = -0.025, 60% of actions crossing), so `coherent` is not a verdict this repository could earn today even with a perfect extractor; and the unit suite's only positive `coherent` case was itself an instance of this defect -- three singleton components, Q = -0.375 by construction -- and was repaired to a partition that actually decomposes (Q = +0.260).
